title: The Ten Commandments
lines: When the Israelites were in the desert, God gave them a special set of rules called the Ten Commandments.
當以色列人在曠野時，神賜給他們一套特別的律例，稱為十誡。
The people were afraid to hear from God.
百姓害怕聽見神的聲音。
So, God spoke these commandments to Moses and Moses told the people.
所以，神將這些誡命告訴摩西，摩西再告訴百姓。
"Do not put any other gods in place of me."
「除了我以外，你不可有別的神。」
"Do not misuse the name of God."
"Do not tell lies about your neighbor."
"Do not want to have anything your neighbor owns."
「不可貪圖你鄰舍所擁有的一切。」
Then, God wrote the commandments on two stone tablets and gave them to Moses.
然後，神將這些誡命寫在兩塊石版上，交給了摩西。
God told Moses that he must teach the people to obey the rules and do all that God had commanded.
神吩咐摩西，他必須教導百姓遵守這些律例，並遵行神所吩咐的一切。
When the Israelites followed God's commandments, they would show the world they lived differently than all others and that they were God's chosen people.
當以色列人遵行神的誡命時，他們便向世界展現出他們的生活方式與眾不同，並且他們是神所揀選的子民。
